title: Data classification
subtitle: 4-level HR data classification: per-level access, export and audit rules.

levels.intro: For each level, define which roles may access the data, whether export is allowed, and the encryption and audit requirements. Only the tenant administrator can change these rules.
levels.readOnlyHint: Read-only — only the administrator can edit the rules.
levels.enforcementExport: Exports are refused when the level or the role does not allow them: employee list, payroll ledger, SAGE exports and CNPS declaration. Every refusal is recorded in the audit trail.
levels.enforcementMask: Pay data is masked on screens and documents (employee record, contracts, career, offboarding, recruitment, reporting, assistant) for roles excluded from the level.
levels.enforcementSelf: Two deliberate limits: the grid can only tighten — it never reopens what permissions close — and it does not apply to an employee viewing their own record.

categories.intro: Mapping of HR data categories to their classification level.
categories.label: Label
